stemMd: Which conclusion is supported about temperature in distilled water?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every temperature above20degrees C prevents germination.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Of the tested temperatures,20degrees C gave the greatest mean germination by day5

explanationMd: The counts6,16,12 establish the highest observed mean at20degrees. They do not locate an exact optimum among untested temperatures or prove no later germination.
